description: Enroll one contact in a Blujay workflow, which starts its sequence of texts to them. This sends a real text to a real person; there is no test mode. Look the contact up first with find_contacts (or create them with save_contact) to get their contact_id, and get the workflow_id from list_workflows. Only workflows that start manually can be enrolled; a tag-triggered workflow starts when you tag the contact with save_contact. A contact who opted out is never enrolled, and a contact already in an unfinished run of the workflow isn't enrolled twice. `request_id` makes retries safe: the same request_id never enrolls the contact twice. Leave it out and this server reuses one for the same workflow and contact for 10 minutes; pass a new one only when the user really wants the contact enrolled again.

metadata.description: Optional notes stored with the enrollment, such as its source. Up to 20 keys. Workflow steps can't read it and it doesn't change what's sent.

request_id.description: Your ID for this enrollment, such as a signup or order ID. Sending it again returns the first result instead of enrolling twice.

name: enroll_in_workflow
title: Start a workflow for a contact
